abbott_smith_html:
θεός, -οῦ, ὁ, ἡ (Act.19:37 only; see M, Pr., 60, 244), late voc., θεέ (Mat.27:46; cf. Deu.3:24, al.),
[in LXX chiefly for אֱלֹהִים, also for אֵל and other cognate forms, יהוה, etc. ;]
a god or deity, God.
__1. In polytheistic sense, a god or deity: Act.28:6, 1Co.8:4, 2Th.2:4, al.; pl., Ac. 14:11 19:26, Gal.4:8, al.
__2. Of the one true God;
__(a) anarthrous: Mat.6:24, Luk.20:38, al.; esp. with prep. (Kühner 3, iii, 605), ἀπὸ θ., Jhn.3:2; ἐκ, Act.5:39, 2Co.5:1, Php.3:9; ὑπό, Rom.13:1; παρὰ θεοῦ, Jhn.1:6; παρὰ θεῷ, 2Th.1:6, 1Pe.2:4; κατὰ θεόν, Rom.8:27, 2Co.7:9, 10; also when in genitive dependent on an anarth. noun (Bl., §46, 6), Mat.27:43, Luk.3:2, Rom.1:17, 1Th.2:13; as pred., Lk 20:38, Jhn.1:1, and when the nature and character rather than the person of God is meant, Act.5:29, Gal.2:6, al. (M, Th., 14);
__(b) more freq., with art.: Mat.1:23, Mrk.2:7, al. mult.; with prep., ἀπὸ τ. θ., Luk.1:26; ἐκ, Jhn.8:42, al.; παρὰ τοῦ θ., Jhn.8:40; π. τῷ θ., Rom.9:14; ἐν, Col.3:3; ἐπὶ τῷ θ., Luk.1:47; ἐπὶ τὸν θ., Act.15:19; εἰς τ. θ., Act.24:15; πρὸς τ. θ., Jhn.1:2; with genitive of person(s), Mat.22:32, Mrk.12:26, 27, Luk.20:37, Jhn.20:17, al.; ὁ θ. μου, Rom.1:8, Php 1:3, al.; ὁ θ. καὶ πατήρ κ. τ. λ., Rom.15:6, Eph.1:3, Phi 4:20, al.; with genitive of thing(s), Rom.15:5, 13, 33, 2Co.1:3, 1Th.5:23; τὰ τ. θεοῦ, Mat.16:23, Mrk.12:17, 1Co.2:11; τὰ πρὸς τὸν θ., Rom.15:17, Heb.2:17 5:1; τ. θεῷ, as a superl. (LXX, Jos.3:3), Act.7:20, 2Co.10:4; Hebraistically, of judges (Psa.81(82):6), Jhn.10:34" (LXX), 35.
(AS)

occurrences.bsb: Then He declared, “Truly, truly, I tell you, you will all see heaven open and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
occurrences.kjv: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.

occurrences.bsb: He came to Jesus at night and said, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs You are doing if God were not with him.”
occurrences.kjv: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

occurrences.bsb: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

occurrences.bsb: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.
occurrences.kjv: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever believes in Him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe has already been condemned, because he has not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son.
occurrences.kjv: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

occurrences.bsb: But whoever practices the truth comes into the Light, so that it may be seen clearly that what he has done has been accomplished in God.”
occurrences.kjv: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever accepts His testimony has certified that God is truthful.
occurrences.kjv: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.

occurrences.bsb: For the One whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.
occurrences.kjv: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life. Whoever rejects the Son will not see life. Instead, the wrath of God remains on him.”
occurrences.kjv: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

occurrences.bsb: God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth.”
occurrences.kjv: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

occurrences.bsb: Because of this, the Jews tried all the harder to kill Him. Not only was He breaking the Sabbath, but He was even calling God His own Father, making Himself equal with God.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.

occurrences.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, the hour is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
occurrences.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.

occurrences.bsb: but I know you, that you do not have the love of God within you.
occurrences.kjv: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.

occurrences.bsb: How can you believe if you accept glory from one another, yet do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?
occurrences.kjv: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?

occurrences.bsb: Do not work for food that perishes, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on Him God the Father has placed His seal of approval.”
occurrences.kjv: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.

occurrences.bsb: Then they inquired, “What must we do to perform the works of God?”
occurrences.kjv: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “The work of God is this: to believe in the One He has sent.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.

occurrences.bsb: For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”
occurrences.kjv: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.

occurrences.bsb: It is written in the Prophets: ‘And they will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from Him comes to Me—
occurrences.kjv: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.

occurrences.bsb: not that anyone has seen the Father except the One who is from God; only He has seen the Father.
occurrences.kjv: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.

occurrences.bsb: We believe and know that You are the Holy One of God.”
occurrences.kjv: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone desires to do His will, he will know whether My teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own.
occurrences.kjv: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

occurrences.bsb: But now you are trying to kill Me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham never did such a thing.
occurrences.kjv: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.

occurrences.bsb: You are doing the works of your father.” “We are not illegitimate children,” they declared. “Our only Father is God Himself.”
occurrences.kjv: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love Me, for I have come here from God. I have not come on My own, but He sent Me.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever belongs to God hears the words of God. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God.”
occurrences.kjv: He that is of God heareth God’s words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “If I glorify Myself, My glory means nothing. The One who glorifies Me is My Father, of whom you say, ‘He is our God.’
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “Neither this man nor his parents sinned, but this happened so that the works of God would be displayed in him.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.

occurrences.bsb: Because of this, some of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, for He does not keep the Sabbath.” But others said, “How can a sinful man perform such signs?” And there was division among them.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.

occurrences.bsb: So a second time they called for the man who had been blind and said, “Give glory to God! We know that this man is a sinner.”
occurrences.kjv: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

occurrences.bsb: We know that God spoke to Moses, but we do not know where this man is from.”
occurrences.kjv: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.

occurrences.bsb: We know that God does not listen to sinners, but He does listen to the one who worships Him and does His will.
occurrences.kjv: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.

occurrences.bsb: If this man were not from God, He could do no such thing.”
occurrences.kjv: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.

occurrences.bsb: “We are not stoning You for any good work,” said the Jews, “but for blasphemy, because You, who are a man, make Yourself out to be God.”
occurrences.kjv: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “Is it not written in your Law: ‘I have said you are gods’?
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

occurrences.bsb: If he called them gods to whom the word of God came—and the Scripture cannot be broken—
occurrences.kjv: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;

occurrences.bsb: then what about the One whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world? How then can you accuse Me of blasphemy for stating that I am the Son of God?
occurrences.kjv: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus heard this, He said, “This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.”
occurrences.kjv: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.

occurrences.bsb: But even now I know that God will give You whatever You ask of Him.”
occurrences.kjv: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.

occurrences.bsb: “Yes, Lord,” she answered, “I believe that You are the Christ, the Son of God, who was to come into the world.”
occurrences.kjv: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God?”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

occurrences.bsb: and not only for the nation, but also for the scattered children of God, to gather them together into one.
occurrences.kjv: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.

occurrences.bsb: For they loved praise from men more than praise from God.
occurrences.kjv: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus knew that the Father had delivered all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was returning to God.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;

occurrences.bsb: When Judas had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in Him.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.

occurrences.bsb: If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify the Son in Himself—and will glorify Him at once.
occurrences.kjv: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.

occurrences.bsb: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.
occurrences.kjv: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

occurrences.bsb: They will put you out of the synagogues. In fact, a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering a service to God.
occurrences.kjv: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.

occurrences.bsb: For the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came from God.
occurrences.kjv: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.

occurrences.bsb: Now we understand that You know all things and that You have no need for anyone to question You. Because of this, we believe that You came from God.”
occurrences.kjv: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.

occurrences.bsb: Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.
occurrences.kjv: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.

occurrences.bsb: “We have a law,” answered the Jews, “and according to that law He must die, because He declared Himself to be the Son of God.”
occurrences.kjv: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

occurrences.bsb: “Do not cling to Me,” Jesus said, “for I have not yet ascended to the Father. But go and tell My brothers, ‘I am ascending to My Father and your Father, to My God and your God.’”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.

occurrences.bsb: Thomas replied, “My Lord and my God!”
occurrences.kjv: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.

occurrences.bsb: But these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in His name.
occurrences.kjv: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. And after He had said this, He told him, “Follow Me.”
occurrences.kjv: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.

occurrences.bsb: After His suffering, He presented Himself to them with many convincing proofs that He was alive. He appeared to them over a span of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.
occurrences.kjv: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:

occurrences.bsb: both Jews and converts to Judaism; Cretans and Arabs—we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues!”
occurrences.kjv: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.

occurrences.bsb: ‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.
occurrences.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:

occurrences.bsb: Men of Israel, listen to this message: Jesus of Nazareth was a man certified by God to you by miracles, wonders, and signs, which God did among you through Him, as you yourselves know.
occurrences.kjv: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:

occurrences.bsb: He was delivered up by God’s set plan and foreknowledge, and you, by the hands of the lawless, put Him to death by nailing Him to the cross.
occurrences.kjv: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:

occurrences.bsb: But God raised Him from the dead, releasing Him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for death to keep Him in its grip.
occurrences.kjv: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.

occurrences.bsb: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that He would place one of his descendants on his throne.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;

occurrences.bsb: God has raised this Jesus to life, to which we are all witnesses.
occurrences.kjv: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.

occurrences.bsb: Exalted, then, to the right hand of God, He has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore let all Israel know with certainty that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ!”
occurrences.kjv: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.

occurrences.bsb: This promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are far off—to all whom the Lord our God will call to Himself.”
occurrences.kjv: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.

occurrences.bsb: praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people. And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.
occurrences.kjv: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.

occurrences.bsb: He sprang to his feet and began to walk. Then he went with them into the temple courts, walking and leaping and praising God.
occurrences.kjv: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

occurrences.bsb: When all the people saw him walking and praising God,
occurrences.kjv: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:

occurrences.bsb: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified His servant Jesus. You handed Him over and rejected Him before Pilate, even though he had decided to release Him.
occurrences.kjv: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.

occurrences.bsb: You killed the Author of life, but God raised Him from the dead, and we are witnesses of this fact.
occurrences.kjv: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.

occurrences.bsb: But in this way God has fulfilled what He foretold through all the prophets, saying that His Christ would suffer.
occurrences.kjv: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: Heaven must take Him in until the time comes for the restoration of all things, which God announced long ago through His holy prophets.
occurrences.kjv: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.

occurrences.bsb: For Moses said, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers. You must listen to Him in everything He tells you.
occurrences.kjv: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.

occurrences.bsb: And you are sons of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers when He said to Abraham, ‘Through your offspring all the families of the earth will be blessed.’
occurrences.kjv: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.

occurrences.bsb: When God raised up His Servant, He sent Him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways.”
occurrences.kjv: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.

occurrences.bsb: then let this be known to all of you and to all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands before you healed.
occurrences.kjv: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.

occurrences.bsb: But Peter and John replied, “Judge for yourselves whether it is right in God’s sight to listen to you rather than God.
occurrences.kjv: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.

occurrences.bsb: After further threats they let them go. They could not find a way to punish them, because all the people were glorifying God for what had happened.
occurrences.kjv: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.

occurrences.bsb: When the believers heard this, they lifted up their voices to God with one accord. “Sovereign Lord,” they said, “You made the heaven and the earth and the sea and everything in them.
occurrences.kjv: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:

occurrences.bsb: After they had prayed, their meeting place was shaken, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.
occurrences.kjv: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.

occurrences.bsb: Did it not belong to you before it was sold? And after it was sold, was it not at your disposal? How could you conceive such a deed in your heart? You have not lied to men, but to God!”
occurrences.kjv: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.

occurrences.bsb: But Peter and the other apostles replied, “We must obey God rather than men.
occurrences.kjv: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.

occurrences.bsb: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you had killed by hanging Him on a tree.
occurrences.kjv: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.

occurrences.bsb: God exalted Him to His right hand as Prince and Savior, in order to grant repentance and forgiveness of sins to Israel.
occurrences.kjv: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.

occurrences.bsb: We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey Him.”
occurrences.kjv: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.

occurrences.bsb: But if it is from God, you will not be able to stop them. You may even find yourselves fighting against God.”
occurrences.kjv: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.

occurrences.bsb: So the Twelve summoned all the disciples and said, “It is unacceptable for us to neglect the word of God in order to wait on tables.
occurrences.kjv: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.

occurrences.bsb: So the word of God continued to spread. The number of disciples in Jerusalem grew rapidly, and a great number of priests became obedient to the faith.
occurrences.kjv: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

occurrences.bsb: Then they prompted some men to say, “We heard Stephen speak words of blasphemy against Moses and against God.”
occurrences.kjv: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.

occurrences.kjv: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,

occurrences.bsb: God told him that his descendants would be foreigners in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.
occurrences.kjv: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.

occurrences.bsb: ‘But I will punish the nation that enslaves them,’ God said, ‘and afterward they will come forth and worship Me in this place.’
occurrences.kjv: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.

occurrences.kjv: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,

occurrences.kjv: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

occurrences.kjv: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father’s house three months:

occurrences.kjv: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.

occurrences.bsb: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.’ Moses trembled with fear and did not dare to look.
occurrences.kjv: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.

occurrences.kjv: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.

occurrences.bsb: This is the same Moses who told the Israelites, ‘God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers.’
occurrences.kjv: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.

occurrences.bsb: They said to Aaron, ‘Make us gods who will go before us! As for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him.’
occurrences.kjv: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

occurrences.bsb: But God turned away from them and gave them over to the worship of the host of heaven, as it is written in the book of the prophets: ‘Did you bring Me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
occurrences.kjv: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?

occurrences.bsb: You have taken along the tabernacle of Molech and the star of your god Rephan, the idols you made to worship. Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Babylon.’
occurrences.kjv: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.

occurrences.bsb: And our fathers who received it brought it in with Joshua when they dispossessed the nations God drove out before them. It remained until the time of David,
occurrences.kjv: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;

occurrences.bsb: who found favor in the sight of God and asked to provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.
occurrences.kjv: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.

occurrences.bsb: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked intently into heaven and saw the glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.
occurrences.kjv: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

occurrences.bsb: “Look,” he said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God.”
occurrences.kjv: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.

occurrences.bsb: and all the people, from the least to the greatest, heeded his words and said, “This man is the divine power called the Great Power.”
occurrences.kjv: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.

occurrences.bsb: But when they believed Philip as he preached the gospel of the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
occurrences.kjv: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

occurrences.bsb: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them.
occurrences.kjv: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:

occurrences.bsb: But Peter replied, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could buy the gift of God with money!
occurrences.kjv: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.

occurrences.bsb: You have no part or share in our ministry, because your heart is not right before God.
occurrences.kjv: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.

occurrences.bsb: Saul promptly began to proclaim Jesus in the synagogues, declaring, “He is the Son of God.”
occurrences.kjv: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.

occurrences.bsb: He and all his household were devout and God-fearing. He gave generously to the people and prayed to God regularly.
occurrences.kjv: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.

occurrences.bsb: One day at about the ninth hour, he had a clear vision of an angel of God who came to him and said, “Cornelius!”
occurrences.kjv: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.

occurrences.bsb: Cornelius stared at him in fear and asked, “What is it, Lord?” The angel answered, “Your prayers and gifts to the poor have ascended as a memorial offering before God.
occurrences.kjv: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.

occurrences.bsb: The voice spoke to him a second time: “Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.”
occurrences.kjv: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

occurrences.bsb: “Cornelius the centurion has sent us,” they said. “He is a righteous and God-fearing man with a good reputation among the whole Jewish nation. A holy angel instructed him to request your presence in his home so he could hear a message from you.”
occurrences.kjv: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.

occurrences.bsb: He said to them, “You know how unlawful it is for a Jew to associate with a foreigner or visit him. But God has shown me that I should not call any man impure or unclean.
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.

occurrences.bsb: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer has been heard, and your gifts to the poor have been remembered before God.
occurrences.kjv: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.

occurrences.bsb: So I sent for you immediately, and you were kind enough to come. Now then, we are all here in the presence of God to listen to everything the Lord has instructed you to tell us.”
occurrences.kjv: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.

occurrences.bsb: Then Peter began to speak: “I now truly understand that God does not show favoritism,
occurrences.kjv: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:

occurrences.bsb: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, and how Jesus went around doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, because God was with Him.
occurrences.kjv: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.

occurrences.bsb: God raised Him up on the third day and caused Him to be seen—
occurrences.kjv: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;

occurrences.bsb: not by all the people, but by the witnesses God had chosen beforehand, by us who ate and drank with Him after He rose from the dead.
occurrences.kjv: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.

occurrences.bsb: And He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that He is the One appointed by God to judge the living and the dead.
occurrences.kjv: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.

occurrences.bsb: For they heard them speaking in tongues and exalting God. Then Peter said,
occurrences.kjv: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,

occurrences.bsb: The apostles and brothers throughout Judea soon heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.
occurrences.kjv: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

occurrences.bsb: But the voice spoke from heaven a second time, ‘Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.’
occurrences.kjv: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

occurrences.bsb: So if God gave them the same gift He gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to hinder the work of God?”
occurrences.kjv: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?

occurrences.bsb: When they heard this, they had no further objections, and they glorified God, saying, “So then, God has granted even the Gentiles repentance unto life.”
occurrences.kjv: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.

occurrences.bsb: When he arrived and saw the grace of God, he rejoiced and encouraged them all to abide in the Lord with all their hearts.
occurrences.kjv: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: So Peter was kept in prison, but the church was fervently praying to God for him.
occurrences.kjv: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.

occurrences.bsb: And they began to shout, “This is the voice of a god, not a man!”
occurrences.kjv: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.

occurrences.bsb: Immediately, because Herod did not give glory to God, an angel of the Lord struck him down, and he was eaten by worms and died.
occurrences.kjv: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.

occurrences.bsb: But the word of God continued to spread and multiply.
occurrences.kjv: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

occurrences.bsb: When they arrived at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. And John was with them as their helper.
occurrences.kjv: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.

occurrences.bsb: an attendant of the proconsul, Sergius Paulus. The proconsul, a man of intelligence, summoned Barnabas and Saul because he wanted to hear the word of God.
occurrences.kjv: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.

occurrences.bsb: Paul stood up, motioned with his hand, and began to speak: “Men of Israel and you Gentiles who fear God, listen to me!
occurrences.kjv: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.

occurrences.bsb: The God of the people of Israel chose our fathers. He made them into a great people during their stay in Egypt, and with an uplifted arm He led them out of that land.
occurrences.kjv: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.

occurrences.bsb: Then the people asked for a king, and God gave them Saul son of Kish, from the tribe of Benjamin, who ruled forty years.
occurrences.kjv: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.

occurrences.bsb: From the descendants of this man, God has brought to Israel the Savior Jesus, as He promised.
occurrences.kjv: Of this man’s seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:

occurrences.bsb: Brothers, children of Abraham, and you Gentiles who fear God, it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent.
occurrences.kjv: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.

occurrences.bsb: But God raised Him from the dead,
occurrences.kjv: But God raised him from the dead:

occurrences.bsb: He has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising up Jesus. As it is written in the second Psalm: ‘You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.’
occurrences.kjv: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.

occurrences.bsb: For when David had served God’s purpose in his own generation, he fell asleep. His body was buried with his fathers and saw decay.
occurrences.kjv: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:

occurrences.bsb: But the One whom God raised from the dead did not see decay.
occurrences.kjv: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.

occurrences.bsb: After the synagogue was dismissed, many of the Jews and devout converts to Judaism followed Paul and Barnabas, who spoke to them and urged them to continue in the grace of God.
occurrences.kjv: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.

occurrences.bsb: Then Paul and Barnabas answered them boldly: “It was necessary to speak the word of God to you first. But since you reject it and do not consider yourselves worthy of eternal life, we now turn to the Gentiles.
occurrences.kjv: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.

occurrences.bsb: When the crowds saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices in the Lycaonian language: “The gods have come down to us in human form!”
occurrences.kjv: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.

occurrences.bsb: “Men, why are you doing this? We too are only men, human like you. We are bringing you good news that you should turn from these worthless things to the living God, who made heaven and earth and sea and everything in them.
occurrences.kjv: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:

occurrences.bsb: strengthening the souls of the disciples and encouraging them to continue in the faith. “We must endure many hardships to enter the kingdom of God,” they said.
occurrences.kjv: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.

occurrences.bsb: From Attalia they sailed to Antioch, where they had been commended to the grace of God for the work they had just completed.
occurrences.kjv: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: When they arrived, they gathered the church together and reported all that God had done through them, and how He had opened the door of faith to the Gentiles.
occurrences.kjv: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.

occurrences.bsb: On their arrival in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church and apostles and elders, to whom they reported all that God had done through them.
occurrences.kjv: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.

occurrences.bsb: After much discussion, Peter got up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that in the early days God made a choice among you that the Gentiles would hear from my lips the message of the gospel and believe.
occurrences.kjv: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.

occurrences.bsb: And God, who knows the heart, showed His approval by giving the Holy Spirit to them, just as He did to us.
occurrences.kjv: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;

occurrences.bsb: Now then, why do you test God by placing on the necks of the disciples a yoke that neither we nor our fathers have been able to bear?
occurrences.kjv: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

occurrences.bsb: The whole assembly fell silent as they listened to Barnabas and Paul describing the signs and wonders God had done among the Gentiles through them.
occurrences.kjv: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.

occurrences.bsb: Simon has told us how God first visited the Gentiles to take from them a people to be His own.
occurrences.kjv: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.

occurrences.bsb: It is my judgment, therefore, that we should not cause trouble for the Gentiles who are turning to God.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:

occurrences.bsb: As soon as Paul had seen the vision, we got ready to leave for Macedonia, concluding that God had called us to preach the gospel to them.
occurrences.kjv: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.

occurrences.bsb: Among those listening was a woman named Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth from the city of Thyatira, who was a worshiper of God. The Lord opened her heart to respond to Paul’s message.
occurrences.kjv: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.

occurrences.bsb: This girl followed Paul and the rest of us, shouting, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who are proclaiming to you the way of salvation!”
occurrences.kjv: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.

occurrences.bsb: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening to them.
occurrences.kjv: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.

occurrences.bsb: Then he brought them into his home and set a meal before them. So he and all his household rejoiced that they had come to believe in God.
occurrences.kjv: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.

occurrences.bsb: But when the Jews from Thessalonica learned that Paul was also proclaiming the word of God in Berea, they went there themselves to incite and agitate the crowds.
occurrences.kjv: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.

occurrences.bsb: For as I walked around and examined your objects of worship, I even found an altar with this inscription: TO AN UNKNOWN GOD. Therefore what you worship as something unknown, I now proclaim to you.
occurrences.kjv: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.

occurrences.bsb: The God who made the world and everything in it is the Lord of heaven and earth and does not live in temples made by human hands.
occurrences.kjv: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;

occurrences.bsb: God intended that they would seek Him and perhaps reach out for Him and find Him, though He is not far from each one of us.
occurrences.kjv: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, being offspring of God, we should not think that the Divine Being is like gold or silver or stone, an image formed by man’s skill and imagination.
occurrences.kjv: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man’s device.

occurrences.bsb: Although God overlooked the ignorance of earlier times, He now commands all people everywhere to repent.
occurrences.kjv: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:

occurrences.bsb: So Paul left the synagogue and went next door to the house of Titus Justus, a worshiper of God.
occurrences.kjv: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man’s house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.

occurrences.bsb: So Paul stayed for a year and a half, teaching the word of God among the Corinthians.
occurrences.kjv: And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

occurrences.bsb: “This man is persuading the people to worship God in ways contrary to the law,” they said.
occurrences.kjv: Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.

occurrences.bsb: But as he left, he said, “I will come back to you if God is willing.” And he set sail from Ephesus.
occurrences.kjv: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.

occurrences.bsb: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue. When Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside and explained to him the way of God more accurately.
occurrences.kjv: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.

occurrences.bsb: Then Paul went into the synagogue and spoke boldly there for three months, arguing persuasively about the kingdom of God.
occurrences.kjv: And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.

occurrences.bsb: God did extraordinary miracles through the hands of Paul,
occurrences.kjv: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:

occurrences.bsb: And you can see and hear that not only in Ephesus, but in nearly the whole province of Asia, this Paul has persuaded a great number of people to turn away. He says that man-made gods are no gods at all.
occurrences.kjv: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:

occurrences.bsb: For you have brought these men here, though they have neither robbed our temple nor blasphemed our goddess.
occurrences.kjv: For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.

occurrences.bsb: testifying to Jews and Greeks alike about repentance to God and faith in our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: But I consider my life of no value to me, if only I may finish my course and complete the ministry I have received from the Lord Jesus—the ministry of testifying to the good news of God’s grace.
occurrences.kjv: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.

occurrences.bsb: For I did not shrink back from declaring to you the whole will of God.
occurrences.kjv: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God.

occurrences.bsb: Keep watch over yourselves and the entire flock of which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers. Be shepherds of the church of God, which He purchased with His own blood.
occurrences.kjv: Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.

occurrences.bsb: And now I commit you to God and to the word of His grace, which can build you up and give you an inheritance among all who are sanctified.
occurrences.kjv: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.

occurrences.bsb: Paul greeted them and recounted one by one the things that God had done among the Gentiles through his ministry.
occurrences.kjv: And when he had saluted them, he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry.

occurrences.bsb: When they heard this, they glorified God. Then they said to Paul, “You see, brother, how many thousands of Jews have believed, and all of them are zealous for the law.
occurrences.kjv: And when they heard it, they glorified the Lord, and said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands of Jews there are which believe; and they are all zealous of the law:

occurrences.bsb: “I am a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but raised in this city. I was educated at the feet of Gamaliel in strict conformity to the law of our fathers. I was just as zealous for God as any of you are today.
occurrences.kjv: I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.

occurrences.bsb: Then he said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know His will and to see the Righteous One and to hear His voice.
occurrences.kjv: And he said, The God of our fathers hath chosen thee, that thou shouldest know his will, and see that Just One, and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth.

occurrences.bsb: Paul looked directly at the Sanhedrin and said, “Brothers, I have conducted myself before God in all good conscience to this day.”
occurrences.kjv: And Paul, earnestly beholding the council, said, Men and brethren, I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day.

occurrences.bsb: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! You sit here to judge me according to the law, yet you yourself violate the law by commanding that I be struck.”
occurrences.kjv: Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, thou whited wall: for sittest thou to judge me after the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?

occurrences.bsb: But those standing nearby said, “How dare you insult the high priest of God!”
occurrences.kjv: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God’s high priest?

occurrences.bsb: I do confess to you, however, that I worship the God of our fathers according to the Way, which they call a sect. I believe everything that is laid down by the Law and written in the Prophets,
occurrences.kjv: But this I confess unto thee, that after the way which they call heresy, so worship I the God of my fathers, believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets:

occurrences.bsb: and I have the same hope in God that they themselves cherish, that there will be a resurrection of both the righteous and the wicked.
occurrences.kjv: And have hope toward God, which they themselves also allow, that there shall be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.

occurrences.bsb: In this hope, I strive always to maintain a clear conscience before God and man.
occurrences.kjv: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men.

occurrences.bsb: And now I stand on trial because of my hope in the promise that God made to our fathers,
occurrences.kjv: And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God unto our fathers:

occurrences.bsb: Why would any of you consider it incredible that God raises the dead?
occurrences.kjv: Why should it be thought a thing incredible with you, that God should raise the dead?

occurrences.bsb: to open their eyes, so that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins and an inheritance among those sanctified by faith in Me.’
occurrences.kjv: To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.

occurrences.bsb: First to those in Damascus and Jerusalem, then to everyone in the region of Judea, and then to the Gentiles, I declared that they should repent and turn to God, performing deeds worthy of their repentance.
occurrences.kjv: But shewed first unto them of Damascus, and at Jerusalem, and throughout all the coasts of Judea, and then to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, and do works meet for repentance.

occurrences.bsb: But I have had God’s help to this day, and I stand here to testify to small and great alike. I am saying nothing beyond what the prophets and Moses said would happen:
occurrences.kjv: Having therefore obtained help of God, I continue unto this day, witnessing both to small and great, saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come:

occurrences.bsb: “Short time or long,” Paul replied, “I wish to God that not only you but all who hear me this day may become what I am, except for these chains.”
occurrences.kjv: And Paul said, I would to God, that not only thou, but also all that hear me this day, were both almost, and altogether such as I am, except these bonds.

occurrences.bsb: For just last night an angel of the God to whom I belong and whom I serve stood beside me
occurrences.kjv: For there stood by me this night the angel of God, whose I am, and whom I serve,

occurrences.bsb: and said, ‘Do not be afraid, Paul; you must stand before Caesar. And look, God has granted you the lives of all who sail with you.’
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must be brought before Cesar: and, lo, God hath given thee all them that sail with thee.

occurrences.bsb: So take courage, men, for I believe God that it will happen just as He told me.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.

occurrences.bsb: After he had said this, Paul took bread and gave thanks to God in front of them all. Then he broke it and began to eat.
occurrences.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he took bread, and gave thanks to God in presence of them all: and when he had broken it, he began to eat.

occurrences.bsb: The islanders were expecting him to swell up or suddenly drop dead. But after waiting a long time and seeing nothing unusual happen to him, they changed their minds and said he was a god.
occurrences.kjv: Howbeit they looked when he should have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but after they had looked a great while, and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.

occurrences.bsb: The brothers there had heard about us and traveled as far as the Forum of Appius and the Three Taverns to meet us. When Paul saw them, he was encouraged and gave thanks to God.
occurrences.kjv: And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.

occurrences.bsb: So they set a day to meet with Paul, and many people came to the place he was staying. He expounded to them from morning to evening, testifying about the kingdom of God and persuading them about Jesus from the Law of Moses and the Prophets.
occurrences.kjv: And when they had appointed him a day, there came many to him into his lodging; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God, persuading them concerning Jesus, both out of the law of Moses, and out of the prophets, from morning till evening.

occurrences.bsb: Be advised, therefore, that God’s salvation has been sent to the Gentiles, and they will listen!”
occurrences.kjv: Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and that they will hear it.

occurrences.bsb: Boldly and freely he proclaimed the kingdom of God and taught about the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him.

occurrences.bsb: Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus, called to be an apostle, and set apart for the gospel of God—
occurrences.kjv: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,

occurrences.bsb: and who through the Spirit of holiness was declared with power to be the Son of God by His resurrection from the dead: Jesus Christ our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:

occurrences.bsb: To all in Rome who are loved by God and called to be saints: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, because your faith is being proclaimed all over the world.
occurrences.kjv: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.

occurrences.bsb: God, whom I serve with my spirit in preaching the gospel of His Son, is my witness how constantly I remember you
occurrences.kjv: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;

occurrences.bsb: in my prayers at all times, asking that now at last by God’s will I may succeed in coming to you.
occurrences.kjv: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.

occurrences.bsb: I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, first to the Jew, then to the Greek.
occurrences.kjv: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

occurrences.bsb: For the gospel reveals the righteousness of God that comes by faith from start to finish, just as it is written: “The righteous will live by faith.”
occurrences.kjv: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.

occurrences.bsb: The wrath of God is being revealed from heaven against all the godlessness and wickedness of men who suppress the truth by their wickedness.
occurrences.kjv: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;

occurrences.bsb: For what may be known about God is plain to them, because God has made it plain to them.
occurrences.kjv: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.

occurrences.bsb: For although they knew God, they neither glorified Him as God nor gave thanks to Him, but they became futile in their thinking and darkened in their foolish hearts.
occurrences.kjv: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.

occurrences.bsb: and exchanged the glory of the immortal God for images of mortal man and birds and animals and reptiles.
occurrences.kjv: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore God gave them over in the desires of their hearts to impurity for the dishonoring of their bodies with one another.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:

occurrences.bsb: They exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is forever worthy of praise! Amen.
occurrences.kjv: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: For this reason God gave them over to dishonorable passions. Even their women exchanged natural relations for unnatural ones.
occurrences.kjv: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:

occurrences.bsb: Furthermore, since they did not see fit to acknowledge God, He gave them up to a depraved mind, to do what ought not to be done.
occurrences.kjv: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;

occurrences.bsb: Although they know God’s righteous decree that those who do such things are worthy of death, they not only continue to do these things, but also approve of those who practice them.
occurrences.kjv: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.

occurrences.bsb: And we know that God’s judgment against those who do such things is based on truth.
occurrences.kjv: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.

occurrences.bsb: So when you, O man, pass judgment on others, yet do the same things, do you think you will escape God’s judgment?
occurrences.kjv: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?

occurrences.bsb: Or do you disregard the riches of His kindness, tolerance, and patience, not realizing that God’s kindness leads you to repentance?
occurrences.kjv: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?

occurrences.bsb: But because of your hard and unrepentant heart, you are storing up wrath against yourself for the day of wrath, when God’s righteous judgment will be revealed.
occurrences.kjv: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;

occurrences.bsb: For God does not show favoritism.
occurrences.kjv: For there is no respect of persons with God.

occurrences.bsb: For it is not the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but it is the doers of the law who will be declared righteous.
occurrences.kjv: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.

occurrences.bsb: on the day when God will judge men’s secrets through Christ Jesus, as proclaimed by my gospel.
occurrences.kjv: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.

occurrences.bsb: Now you, if you call yourself a Jew; if you rely on the law and boast in God;
occurrences.kjv: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,

occurrences.bsb: You who boast in the law, do you dishonor God by breaking the law?
occurrences.kjv: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?

occurrences.bsb: As it is written: “God’s name is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you.”
occurrences.kjv: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.

occurrences.bsb: No, a man is a Jew because he is one inwardly, and circumcision is a matter of the heart, by the Spirit, not by the written code. Such a man’s praise does not come from men, but from God.
occurrences.kjv: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.

occurrences.bsb: Much in every way. First of all, they have been entrusted with the very words of God.
occurrences.kjv: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.

occurrences.bsb: What if some did not have faith? Will their lack of faith nullify God’s faithfulness?
occurrences.kjv: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?

occurrences.bsb: Certainly not! Let God be true and every man a liar. As it is written: “So that You may be proved right when You speak and victorious when You judge.”
occurrences.kjv: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.

occurrences.bsb: But if our unrighteousness highlights the righteousness of God, what shall we say? That God is unjust to inflict His wrath on us? I am speaking in human terms.
occurrences.kjv: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)

occurrences.bsb: Certainly not! In that case, how could God judge the world?
occurrences.kjv: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?

occurrences.bsb: However, if my falsehood accentuates God’s truthfulness, to the increase of His glory, why am I still condemned as a sinner?
occurrences.kjv: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?

occurrences.bsb: There is no one who understands, no one who seeks God.
occurrences.kjv: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.

occurrences.bsb: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”
occurrences.kjv: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

occurrences.bsb: Now we know that whatever the law says, it says to those who are under the law, so that every mouth may be silenced and the whole world held accountable to God.
occurrences.kjv: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.

occurrences.bsb: But now, apart from the law, the righteousness of God has been revealed, as attested by the Law and the Prophets.
occurrences.kjv: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;

occurrences.bsb: And this righteousness from God comes through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe. There is no distinction,
occurrences.kjv: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:

occurrences.bsb: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,
occurrences.kjv: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;

occurrences.bsb: God presented Him as an atoning sacrifice in His blood through faith, in order to demonstrate His righteousness, because in His forbearance He had passed over the sins committed beforehand.
occurrences.kjv: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;

occurrences.bsb: Is God the God of Jews only? Is He not the God of Gentiles too? Yes, of Gentiles too,
occurrences.kjv: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:

occurrences.bsb: since there is only one God, who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith.
occurrences.kjv: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.

occurrences.bsb: If Abraham was indeed justified by works, he had something to boast about, but not before God.
occurrences.kjv: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.

occurrences.bsb: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.”
occurrences.kjv: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.

occurrences.bsb: And David speaks likewise of the blessedness of the man to whom God credits righteousness apart from works:
occurrences.kjv: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,

occurrences.bsb: As it is written: “I have made you a father of many nations.” He is our father in the presence of God, in whom he believed, the God who gives life to the dead and calls into being what does not yet exist.
occurrences.kjv: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.

occurrences.bsb: Yet he did not waver through disbelief in the promise of God, but was strengthened in his faith and gave glory to God,
occurrences.kjv: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,
occurrences.kjv: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we stand. And we rejoice in the hope of the glory of God.
occurrences.kjv: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

occurrences.bsb: And hope does not disappoint us, because God has poured out His love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, whom He has given us.
occurrences.kjv: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

occurrences.bsb: But God proves His love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
occurrences.kjv: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

occurrences.bsb: For if, when we were enemies of God, we were reconciled to Him through the death of His Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through His life!
occurrences.kjv: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.

occurrences.bsb: Not only that, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation.
occurrences.kjv: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.

occurrences.bsb: But the gift is not like the trespass. For if the many died by the trespass of the one man, how much more did God’s grace and the gift that came by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many!
occurrences.kjv: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.

occurrences.bsb: The death He died, He died to sin once for all; but the life He lives, He lives to God.
occurrences.kjv: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.

occurrences.bsb: So you too must count yourselves dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
