occurrences.bsb: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
occurrences.kjv: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.

occurrences.bsb: without being frightened in any way by those who oppose you. This is a clear sign of their destruction but of your salvation, and it is from God.
occurrences.kjv: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.

occurrences.bsb: Who, existing in the form of God, did not consider equality with God something to be grasped,
occurrences.kjv: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:

occurrences.bsb: Therefore God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name above all names,
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:

occurrences.bsb: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
occurrences.kjv: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

occurrences.bsb: For it is God who works in you to will and to act on behalf of His good purpose.
occurrences.kjv: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

occurrences.bsb: so that you may be blameless and pure, children of God without fault in a crooked and perverse generation, in which you shine as lights in the world
occurrences.kjv: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;

occurrences.bsb: He was sick indeed, nearly unto death. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, to spare me sorrow upon sorrow.
occurrences.kjv: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

occurrences.bsb: For it is we who are the circumcision, we who worship by the Spirit of God, who glory in Christ Jesus, and who put no confidence in the flesh—
occurrences.kjv: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.

occurrences.bsb: and be found in Him, not having my own righteousness from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness from God on the basis of faith.
occurrences.kjv: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:

occurrences.bsb: I press on toward the goal to win the prize of God’s heavenly calling in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: All of us who are mature should embrace this point of view. And if you think differently about some issue, God will reveal this to you as well.
occurrences.kjv: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.

occurrences.bsb: Their end is destruction, their god is their belly, and their glory is in their shame. Their minds are set on earthly things.
occurrences.kjv: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)

occurrences.bsb: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
occurrences.kjv: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.

occurrences.bsb: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: Whatever you have learned or received or heard from me, or seen in me, put it into practice. And the God of peace will be with you.
occurrences.kjv: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.

occurrences.bsb: I have all I need and more, now that I have received your gifts from Epaphroditus. They are a fragrant offering, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.
occurrences.kjv: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.

occurrences.bsb: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: To our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
occurrences.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,

occurrences.bsb: To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace and peace to you from God our Father.
occurrences.kjv: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you,
occurrences.kjv: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

occurrences.bsb: that has come to you. All over the world this gospel is bearing fruit and growing, just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood the grace of God.
occurrences.kjv: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:

occurrences.bsb: so that you may walk in a manner worthy of the Lord and may please Him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God,
occurrences.kjv: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

occurrences.bsb: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.
occurrences.kjv: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:

occurrences.bsb: I became its servant by the commission God gave me to fully proclaim to you the word of God,
occurrences.kjv: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;

occurrences.bsb: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
occurrences.kjv: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

occurrences.bsb: that they may be encouraged in heart, knit together in love, and filled with the full riches of complete understanding, so that they may know the mystery of God, namely Christ,
occurrences.kjv: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;

occurrences.bsb: And having been buried with Him in baptism, you were raised with Him through your faith in the power of God, who raised Him from the dead.
occurrences.kjv: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.

occurrences.bsb: He has lost connection to the head, from whom the whole body, supported and knit together by its joints and ligaments, grows as God causes it to grow.
occurrences.kjv: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
occurrences.kjv: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.

occurrences.bsb: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.
occurrences.kjv: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

occurrences.bsb: Because of these, the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.
occurrences.kjv: For which things’ sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
occurrences.kjv: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

occurrences.bsb: Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.
occurrences.kjv: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
occurrences.kjv: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

occurrences.bsb: as you pray also for us, that God may open to us a door for the word, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ, for which I am in chains.
occurrences.kjv: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:

occurrences.bsb: Jesus, who is called Justus, also sends greetings. These are the only Jews among my fellow workers for the kingdom of God, and they have been a comfort to me.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.

occurrences.bsb: Epaphras, who is one of you and a servant of Christ Jesus, sends you greetings. He is always wrestling in prayer for you, so that you may stand mature and fully assured in the full will of God.
occurrences.kjv: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

occurrences.bsb: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.
occurrences.kjv: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: We always thank God for all of you, remembering you in our prayers
occurrences.kjv: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;

occurrences.bsb: and continually recalling before our God and Father your work of faith, your labor of love, and your enduring hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;

occurrences.bsb: Brothers who are beloved by God, we know that He has chosen you,
occurrences.kjv: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.

occurrences.bsb: For not only did the message of the Lord ring out from you to Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has gone out to every place, so that we have no need to say anything more.
occurrences.kjv: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.

occurrences.bsb: For they themselves report what kind of welcome you gave us, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God
occurrences.kjv: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;

occurrences.bsb: As you are aware, we had already endured suffering and shameful treatment in Philippi. But in the face of strong opposition, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God.
occurrences.kjv: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.

occurrences.bsb: Instead, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, not in order to please men but God, who examines our hearts.
occurrences.kjv: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.

occurrences.bsb: As you know, we never used words of flattery or any pretext for greed. God is our witness!
occurrences.kjv: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God is witness:

occurrences.bsb: We cared so deeply that we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God, but our own lives as well. That is how beloved you have become to us.
occurrences.kjv: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.

occurrences.bsb: Surely you recall, brothers, our labor and toil. We worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to anyone while we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.
occurrences.kjv: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.

occurrences.bsb: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous, and blameless our conduct was among you who believed.
occurrences.kjv: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:

occurrences.bsb: encouraging you, comforting you, and urging you to walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.
occurrences.kjv: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.

occurrences.bsb: And we continually thank God because, when you received the word of God that you heard from us, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it truly is, the word of God, which is also now at work in you who believe.
occurrences.kjv: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.

occurrences.bsb: For you, brothers, became imitators of the churches of God in Judea that are in Christ Jesus. You suffered from your own countrymen the very things they suffered from the Jews,
occurrences.kjv: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:

occurrences.bsb: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets and drove us out as well. They are displeasing to God and hostile to all men,
occurrences.kjv: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:

occurrences.bsb: We sent Timothy, our brother and fellow worker for God in the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you in your faith,
occurrences.kjv: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:

occurrences.bsb: How can we adequately thank God for you in return for our great joy over you in His presence?
occurrences.kjv: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;

occurrences.bsb: Now may our God and Father Himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you.
occurrences.kjv: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.

occurrences.bsb: so that He may establish your hearts in blamelessness and holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.

occurrences.bsb: Finally, brothers, we ask and encourage you in the Lord Jesus to live in a way that is pleasing to God, just as you have received from us. This is how you already live, so you should do so all the more.
occurrences.kjv: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.

occurrences.bsb: For it is God’s will that you should be holy: You must abstain from sexual immorality;
occurrences.kjv: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:

occurrences.bsb: not in lustful passion like the Gentiles who do not know God;
occurrences.kjv: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:

occurrences.bsb: For God has not called us to impurity, but to holiness.
occurrences.kjv: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.

occurrences.bsb: Anyone, then, who rejects this command does not reject man but God, the very One who gives you His Holy Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.

occurrences.bsb: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, we also believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in Him.
occurrences.kjv: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.

occurrences.bsb: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a loud command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will be the first to rise.
occurrences.kjv: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:

occurrences.bsb: For God has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,

occurrences.bsb: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

occurrences.bsb: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
occurrences.kjv: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: We are obligated to thank God for you all the time, brothers, as is fitting, because your faith is growing more and more, and your love for one another is increasing.
occurrences.kjv: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;

occurrences.bsb: That is why we boast among God’s churches about your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring.
occurrences.kjv: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:

occurrences.bsb: All this is clear evidence of God’s righteous judgment. And so you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.
occurrences.kjv: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:

occurrences.bsb: After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
occurrences.kjv: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;

occurrences.bsb: in blazing fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: To this end, we always pray for you, that our God will count you worthy of His calling, and that He will powerfully fulfill your every good desire and work of faith,
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:

occurrences.bsb: so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: He will oppose and exalt himself above every so-called god or object of worship. So he will seat himself in the temple of God, proclaiming himself to be God.
occurrences.kjv: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.

occurrences.bsb: For this reason God will send them a powerful delusion so that they believe the lie,
occurrences.kjv: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:

occurrences.bsb: But we should always thank God for you, brothers who are loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning to be saved by the sanctification of the Spirit and by faith in the truth.
occurrences.kjv: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:

occurrences.bsb: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who by grace has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope,
occurrences.kjv: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

occurrences.bsb: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,
occurrences.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;

occurrences.bsb: To Timothy, my true child in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

occurrences.bsb: or devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies, which promote speculation rather than the stewardship of God’s work, which is by faith.
occurrences.kjv: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.

occurrences.bsb: that agrees with the glorious gospel of the blessed God, with which I have been entrusted.
occurrences.kjv: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

occurrences.bsb: Now to the King eternal, immortal, and invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: This is good and pleasing in the sight of God our Savior,
occurrences.kjv: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;

occurrences.bsb: For there is one God, and there is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
occurrences.kjv: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

occurrences.bsb: For if someone does not know how to manage his own household, how can he care for the church of God?
occurrences.kjv: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)

occurrences.bsb: in case I am delayed, so that you will know how each one must conduct himself in God’s household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.
occurrences.kjv: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

occurrences.bsb: They will prohibit marriage and require abstinence from certain foods that God has created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
occurrences.kjv: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.

occurrences.bsb: For every creation of God is good, and nothing that is received with thanksgiving should be rejected,
occurrences.kjv: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:

occurrences.bsb: because it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
occurrences.kjv: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.

occurrences.bsb: To this end we labor and strive, because we have set our hope on the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, and especially of those who believe.
occurrences.kjv: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.

occurrences.bsb: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they must first learn to show godliness to their own family and repay their parents, for this is pleasing in the sight of God.
occurrences.kjv: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.

occurrences.bsb: The widow who is truly in need and left all alone puts her hope in God and continues night and day in her petitions and prayers.
occurrences.kjv: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.

occurrences.bsb: I solemnly charge you before God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels to maintain these principles without bias, and to do nothing out of partiality.
occurrences.kjv: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.

occurrences.bsb: All who are under the yoke of slavery should regard their masters as fully worthy of honor, so that God’s name and our teaching will not be discredited.
occurrences.kjv: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.

occurrences.bsb: But you, O man of God, flee from these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
occurrences.kjv: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.

occurrences.bsb: I charge you in the presence of God, who gives life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who made the good confession in His testimony before Pontius Pilate:
occurrences.kjv: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;

occurrences.bsb: Instruct those who are rich in the present age not to be conceited and not to put their hope in the uncertainty of wealth, but in God, who richly provides all things for us to enjoy.
occurrences.kjv: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;

occurrences.bsb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, according to the promise of life in Christ Jesus,
occurrences.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,

occurrences.bsb: To Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

occurrences.bsb: I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience as did my forefathers, as I constantly remember you night and day in my prayers.
occurrences.kjv: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;

occurrences.bsb: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.

occurrences.bsb: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
occurrences.kjv: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

occurrences.bsb: So do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, or of me, His prisoner. Instead, join me in suffering for the gospel by the power of God.
occurrences.kjv: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;

occurrences.bsb: for which I suffer to the extent of being chained like a criminal. But the word of God cannot be chained!
occurrences.kjv: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.

occurrences.bsb: Make every effort to present yourself approved to God, an unashamed workman who accurately handles the word of truth.
occurrences.kjv: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

occurrences.bsb: Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His,” and, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from iniquity.”
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

occurrences.bsb: He must gently reprove those who oppose him, in the hope that God may grant them repentance leading to a knowledge of the truth.
occurrences.kjv: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

occurrences.bsb: so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.
occurrences.kjv: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

occurrences.bsb: I charge you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of His appearing and His kingdom:
occurrences.kjv: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;

occurrences.bsb: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ for the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness,
occurrences.kjv: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;

occurrences.bsb: in the hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began.
occurrences.kjv: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;

occurrences.bsb: In His own time He has made His word evident in the proclamation entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior.
occurrences.kjv: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;

occurrences.bsb: To Titus, my true child in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.
occurrences.kjv: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.

occurrences.bsb: As God’s steward, an overseer must be above reproach—not self-willed, not quick-tempered, not given to drunkenness, not violent, not greedy for money.
occurrences.kjv: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;

occurrences.bsb: They profess to know God, but by their actions they deny Him. They are detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good deed.
occurrences.kjv: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.

occurrences.bsb: to be self-controlled, pure, managers of their households, kind, and submissive to their own husbands, so that the word of God will not be discredited.
occurrences.kjv: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.

occurrences.bsb: not stealing from them, but showing all good faith, so that in every respect they will adorn the teaching about God our Savior.
occurrences.kjv: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

occurrences.bsb: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.
occurrences.kjv: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,

occurrences.bsb: as we await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

occurrences.bsb: But when the kindness of God our Savior and His love for mankind appeared,
occurrences.kjv: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,

occurrences.bsb: This saying is trustworthy. And I want you to emphasize these things, so that those who have believed God will take care to devote themselves to good deeds. These things are excellent and profitable for the people.
occurrences.kjv: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.

occurrences.bsb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: I always thank my God, remembering you in my prayers,
occurrences.kjv: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,

occurrences.bsb: On many past occasions and in many different ways, God spoke to our fathers through the prophets.
occurrences.kjv: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,

occurrences.bsb: And again, when God brings His firstborn into the world, He says: “Let all God’s angels worship Him.”
occurrences.kjv: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.

occurrences.bsb: But about the Son He says: “Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
occurrences.kjv: But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.

occurrences.bsb: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, Your God, has anointed You above Your companions with the oil of joy.”
occurrences.kjv: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

occurrences.bsb: and was affirmed by God through signs, wonders, various miracles, and gifts of the Holy Spirit distributed according to His will.
occurrences.kjv: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?

occurrences.bsb: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels, now crowned with glory and honor because He suffered death, so that by the grace of God He might taste death for everyone.
occurrences.kjv: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.

occurrences.bsb: And again: “I will put My trust in Him.” And once again: “Here am I, and the children God has given Me.”
occurrences.kjv: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.

occurrences.bsb: For this reason He had to be made like His brothers in every way, so that He might become a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God, in order to make atonement for the sins of the people.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.

occurrences.bsb: And every house is built by someone, but God is the builder of everything.
occurrences.kjv: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.

occurrences.bsb: See to it, brothers, that none of you has a wicked heart of unbelief that turns away from the living God.
occurrences.kjv: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.

occurrences.bsb: For somewhere He has spoken about the seventh day in this manner: “And on the seventh day God rested from all His works.”
occurrences.kjv: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.

occurrences.bsb: There remains, then, a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
occurrences.kjv: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.

occurrences.bsb: For whoever enters God’s rest also rests from his own work, just as God did from His.
occurrences.kjv: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.

occurrences.bsb: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
occurrences.kjv: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to what we profess.
occurrences.kjv: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.

occurrences.bsb: Every high priest is appointed from among men to represent them in matters relating to God, to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins.
occurrences.kjv: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:

occurrences.bsb: No one takes this honor upon himself; he must be called by God, just as Aaron was.
occurrences.kjv: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.

occurrences.bsb: and was designated by God as high priest in the order of Melchizedek.
occurrences.kjv: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.

occurrences.bsb: Although by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to reteach you the basic principles of God’s word. You need milk, not solid food!
occurrences.kjv: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore let us leave the elementary teachings about Christ and go on to maturity, not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith in God,
occurrences.kjv: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,

occurrences.bsb: And this we will do, if God permits.
occurrences.kjv: And this will we do, if God permit.

occurrences.bsb: who have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the coming age—
occurrences.kjv: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,

occurrences.bsb: and then have fallen away—to be restored to repentance, because they themselves are crucifying the Son of God all over again and subjecting Him to open shame.
occurrences.kjv: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.

occurrences.bsb: For land that drinks in the rain often falling on it and that produces a crop useful to those for whom it is tended receives the blessing of God.
occurrences.kjv: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:

occurrences.bsb: For God is not unjust. He will not forget your work and the love you have shown for His name as you have ministered to the saints and continue to do so.
occurrences.kjv: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.

occurrences.bsb: When God made His promise to Abraham, since He had no one greater to swear by, He swore by Himself,
occurrences.kjv: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,

occurrences.bsb: So when God wanted to make the unchanging nature of His purpose very clear to the heirs of the promise, He guaranteed it with an oath.
occurrences.kjv: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:

occurrences.bsb: Thus by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be strongly encouraged.
occurrences.kjv: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:

occurrences.bsb: This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
occurrences.kjv: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;

occurrences.bsb: Without father or mother or genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life, like the Son of God, he remains a priest for all time.
occurrences.kjv: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.

occurrences.bsb: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a better hope is introduced, by which we draw near to God.
occurrences.kjv: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore He is able to save completely those who draw near to God through Him, since He always lives to intercede for them.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.

occurrences.bsb: For this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their minds and inscribe them on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people.
occurrences.kjv: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:

occurrences.bsb: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered Himself unblemished to God, purify our consciences from works of death, so that we may serve the living God!
occurrences.kjv: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

occurrences.bsb: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant, which God has commanded you to keep.”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.

occurrences.bsb: For Christ did not enter a man-made copy of the true sanctuary, but He entered heaven itself, now to appear on our behalf in the presence of God.
occurrences.kjv: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:

occurrences.bsb: Then I said, ‘Here I am, it is written about Me in the scroll: I have come to do Your will, O God.’”
occurrences.kjv: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.

occurrences.bsb: But when this Priest had offered for all time one sacrifice for sins, He sat down at the right hand of God.
occurrences.kjv: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;

occurrences.bsb: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,
occurrences.kjv: And having an high priest over the house of God;

occurrences.bsb: How much more severely do you think one deserves to be punished who has trampled on the Son of God, profaned the blood of the covenant that sanctified him, and insulted the Spirit of grace?
occurrences.kjv: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?

occurrences.bsb: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
occurrences.kjv: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

occurrences.bsb: You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.
occurrences.kjv: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.

occurrences.bsb: By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible.
occurrences.kjv: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.

occurrences.bsb: By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. By faith he was commended as righteous when God gave approval to his gifts. And by faith he still speaks, even though he is dead.
occurrences.kjv: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.

occurrences.bsb: By faith Enoch was taken up so that he did not see death: “He could not be found, because God had taken him away.” For before he was taken, he was commended as one who pleased God.
occurrences.kjv: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.

occurrences.bsb: And without faith it is impossible to please God. For anyone who approaches Him must believe that He exists and that He rewards those who earnestly seek Him.
occurrences.kjv: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

occurrences.bsb: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.
occurrences.kjv: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

occurrences.bsb: Instead, they were longing for a better country, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for He has prepared a city for them.
occurrences.kjv: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.

occurrences.bsb: Abraham reasoned that God could raise the dead, and in a sense, he did receive Isaac back from death.
occurrences.kjv: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.

occurrences.bsb: He chose to suffer oppression with God’s people rather than to experience the fleeting enjoyment of sin.
occurrences.kjv: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;

occurrences.bsb: God had planned something better for us, so that together with us they would be made perfect.
occurrences.kjv: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.

occurrences.bsb: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
occurrences.kjv: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

occurrences.bsb: Endure suffering as discipline; God is treating you as sons. For what son is not disciplined by his father?
occurrences.kjv: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?

occurrences.bsb: See to it that no one falls short of the grace of God, and that no root of bitterness springs up to cause trouble and defile many.
occurrences.kjv: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;

occurrences.bsb: Instead, you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem. You have come to myriads of angels
occurrences.kjv: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,

occurrences.bsb: in joyful assembly, to the congregation of the firstborn, enrolled in heaven. You have come to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,
occurrences.kjv: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom, let us be filled with gratitude, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:

occurrences.bsb: “For our God is a consuming fire.”
occurrences.kjv: For our God is a consuming fire.

occurrences.bsb: Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
occurrences.kjv: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.

occurrences.bsb: Remember your leaders who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.
occurrences.kjv: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.

occurrences.bsb: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.
occurrences.kjv: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.

occurrences.bsb: And do not neglect to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.
occurrences.kjv: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

occurrences.bsb: Now may the God of peace, who through the blood of the eternal covenant brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep,
occurrences.kjv: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,

occurrences.bsb: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes of the Dispersion: Greetings.
occurrences.kjv: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.

occurrences.bsb: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
occurrences.kjv: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

occurrences.bsb: When tempted, no one should say, “God is tempting me.” For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does He tempt anyone.
occurrences.kjv: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:

occurrences.bsb: for man’s anger does not bring about the righteousness that God desires.
occurrences.kjv: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.

occurrences.bsb: Pure and undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.
occurrences.kjv: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.

occurrences.bsb: Listen, my beloved brothers: Has not God chosen the poor of this world to be rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom He promised those who love Him?
occurrences.kjv: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?

occurrences.bsb: You believe that God is one. Good for you! Even the demons believe that—and shudder.
occurrences.kjv: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.

occurrences.bsb: And the Scripture was fulfilled that says, “Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness,” and he was called a friend of God.
occurrences.kjv: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.

occurrences.bsb: With the tongue we bless our Lord and Father, and with it we curse men, who have been made in God’s likeness.
occurrences.kjv: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.

occurrences.bsb: You adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Therefore, whoever chooses to be a friend of the world renders himself an enemy of God.
occurrences.kjv: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.

occurrences.bsb: But He gives us more grace. This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
occurrences.kjv: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.

occurrences.bsb: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
occurrences.kjv: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

occurrences.bsb: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
occurrences.kjv: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.

occurrences.bsb: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father and sanctified by the Spirit for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by His blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance.
occurrences.kjv: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! By His great mercy He has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
occurrences.kjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

occurrences.bsb: who through faith are shielded by God’s power for the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.
occurrences.kjv: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

occurrences.bsb: Through Him you believe in God, who raised Him from the dead and glorified Him; and so your faith and hope are in God.
occurrences.kjv: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.

occurrences.bsb: For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.
occurrences.kjv: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.

occurrences.bsb: As you come to Him, the living stone, rejected by men but chosen and precious in God’s sight,
occurrences.kjv: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,

occurrences.bsb: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
occurrences.kjv: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

occurrences.bsb: Conduct yourselves with such honor among the Gentiles that, though they slander you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day He visits us.
occurrences.kjv: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.

occurrences.bsb: For it is God’s will that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish men.
occurrences.kjv: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

occurrences.bsb: Live in freedom, but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil; live as servants of God.
occurrences.kjv: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.

occurrences.bsb: Treat everyone with high regard: Love the brotherhood of believers, fear God, honor the king.
occurrences.kjv: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.

occurrences.bsb: For if anyone endures the pain of unjust suffering because he is conscious of God, this is to be commended.
occurrences.kjv: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.

occurrences.bsb: How is it to your credit if you are beaten for doing wrong and you endure it? But if you suffer for doing good and you endure it, this is commendable before God.
occurrences.kjv: For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.

occurrences.bsb: but from the inner disposition of your heart, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is precious in God’s sight.
occurrences.kjv: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.

occurrences.bsb: For this is how the holy women of the past adorned themselves. They put their hope in God and were submissive to their husbands,
occurrences.kjv: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:

occurrences.bsb: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
occurrences.kjv: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.

occurrences.bsb: For Christ also suffered for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in the body but made alive in the Spirit,
occurrences.kjv: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:

occurrences.bsb: who disobeyed long ago when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ark was being built. In the ark a few people, only eight souls, were saved through water.
occurrences.kjv: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.

occurrences.bsb: And this water symbolizes the baptism that now saves you also—not the removal of dirt from the body, but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
occurrences.kjv: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of God, with angels, authorities, and powers subject to Him.
occurrences.kjv: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.

occurrences.bsb: Consequently, he does not live out his remaining time on earth for human passions, but for the will of God.
occurrences.kjv: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.

occurrences.bsb: That is why the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged as men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
occurrences.kjv: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.

occurrences.bsb: As good stewards of the manifold grace of God, each of you should use whatever gift he has received to serve one another.
occurrences.kjv: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
occurrences.kjv: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.

occurrences.bsb: But if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but glorify God that you bear that name.
occurrences.kjv: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.

occurrences.bsb: For it is time for judgment to begin with the family of God; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who disobey the gospel of God?
occurrences.kjv: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?

occurrences.bsb: So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should entrust their souls to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.

occurrences.bsb: Be shepherds of God’s flock that is among you, watching over them not out of compulsion, but willingly, as God would have you; not out of greed, but out of eagerness;
occurrences.kjv: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;

occurrences.bsb: Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
occurrences.kjv: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.

occurrences.bsb: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you.
occurrences.kjv: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:

occurrences.bsb: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
occurrences.kjv: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

occurrences.bsb: Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.
occurrences.kjv: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.

occurrences.bsb: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ have received a faith as precious as ours:
occurrences.kjv: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: Grace and peace be multiplied to you through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,

occurrences.bsb: For He received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to Him from the Majestic Glory, saying, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
occurrences.kjv: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

occurrences.bsb: For no such prophecy was ever brought forth by the will of man, but men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.

occurrences.bsb: For if God did not spare the angels when they sinned, but cast them deep into hell, placing them in chains of darkness to be held for judgment;
occurrences.kjv: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

occurrences.bsb: But they deliberately overlook the fact that long ago by God’s word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water,
occurrences.kjv: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:

occurrences.bsb: as you anticipate and hasten the coming of the day of God, when the heavens will be destroyed by fire and the elements will melt in the heat.
occurrences.kjv: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?

occurrences.bsb: And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.
occurrences.kjv: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

occurrences.bsb: But if anyone keeps His word, the love of God has been truly perfected in him. By this we know that we are in Him:
occurrences.kjv: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.

occurrences.bsb: I have written to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
occurrences.kjv: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.

occurrences.bsb: The world is passing away, along with its desires; but whoever does the will of God remains forever.
occurrences.kjv: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.

occurrences.bsb: Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.

occurrences.bsb: The one who practices sin is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the very start. This is why the Son of God was revealed, to destroy the works of the devil.
occurrences.kjv: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

occurrences.bsb: Anyone born of God refuses to practice sin, because God’s seed abides in him; he cannot go on sinning, because he has been born of God.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.

occurrences.bsb: By this the children of God are distinguished from the children of the devil: Anyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor is anyone who does not love his brother.
occurrences.kjv: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone with earthly possessions sees his brother in need, but withholds his compassion from him, how can the love of God abide in him?
occurrences.kjv: But whoso hath this world’s good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?

occurrences.bsb: Even if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts, and He knows all things.
occurrences.kjv: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God,
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

occurrences.bsb: By this you will know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,
occurrences.kjv: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:

occurrences.bsb: and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and which is already in the world at this time.
occurrences.kjv: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.

occurrences.bsb: You, little children, are from God and have overcome them, because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.
occurrences.kjv: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

occurrences.bsb: We are from God. Whoever knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. That is how we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of deception.
occurrences.kjv: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
occurrences.kjv: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

occurrences.bsb: This is how God’s love was revealed among us: God sent His one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.
occurrences.kjv: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.

occurrences.bsb: And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
occurrences.kjv: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.

occurrences.bsb: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.
occurrences.kjv: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.

occurrences.bsb: And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
occurrences.kjv: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
occurrences.kjv: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?

occurrences.bsb: And we have this commandment from Him: Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.
occurrences.kjv: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.

occurrences.bsb: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him.
