occurrences.kjv: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.

occurrences.bsb: By this we know that we love the children of God: when we love God and keep His commandments.
occurrences.kjv: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.

occurrences.bsb: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome,
occurrences.kjv: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.

occurrences.bsb: because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
occurrences.kjv: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.

occurrences.bsb: Who then overcomes the world? Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
occurrences.kjv: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?

occurrences.bsb: Even if we accept human testimony, the testimony of God is greater. For this is the testimony that God has given about His Son.
occurrences.kjv: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony within him; whoever does not believe God has made Him out to be a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given about His Son.
occurrences.kjv: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.

occurrences.bsb: And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
occurrences.kjv: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.
occurrences.kjv: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.

occurrences.bsb: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.

occurrences.bsb: We know that anyone born of God does not keep on sinning; the One who was born of God protects him, and the evil one cannot touch him.
occurrences.kjv: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.

occurrences.bsb: We know that we are of God, and that the whole world is under the power of the evil one.
occurrences.kjv: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.

occurrences.bsb: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true—in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

occurrences.bsb: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, will be with us in truth and love.
occurrences.kjv: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

occurrences.bsb: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.

occurrences.bsb: They have testified to the church about your love. You will do well to send them on their way in a manner worthy of God.
occurrences.kjv: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is of God; the one who does evil has not seen God.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.

occurrences.bsb: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James, To those who are called, loved by God the Father, and kept in Jesus Christ:
occurrences.kjv: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:

occurrences.bsb: For certain men have crept in among you unnoticed—ungodly ones who were designated long ago for condemnation. They turn the grace of our God into a license for immorality, and they deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: keep yourselves in the love of God as you await the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.

occurrences.bsb: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: This is the revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants what must soon come to pass. He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John,
occurrences.kjv: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:

occurrences.bsb: who testifies to everything he saw. This is the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.

occurrences.bsb: who has made us to be a kingdom, priests to His God and Father—to Him be the glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
occurrences.kjv: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, who is and was and is to come—the Almighty.
occurrences.kjv: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.

occurrences.bsb: I, John, your brother and partner in the tribulation and kingdom and perseverance that are in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and my testimony about Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to eat from the tree of life in the Paradise of God.
occurrences.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.

occurrences.bsb: To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like a blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze.
occurrences.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;

occurrences.bsb: “To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of the One who holds the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds; you have a reputation for being alive, yet you are dead.
occurrences.kjv: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.

occurrences.bsb: Wake up and strengthen what remains, which is about to die; for I have found your deeds incomplete in the sight of My God.
occurrences.kjv: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.

occurrences.bsb: The one who overcomes I will make a pillar in the temple of My God, and he will never again leave it. Upon him I will write the name of My God, and the name of the city of My God (the new Jerusalem that comes down out of heaven from My God), and My new name.
occurrences.kjv: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.

occurrences.bsb: To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the Originator of God’s creation.
occurrences.kjv: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;

occurrences.bsb: From the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblings, and peals of thunder. Before the throne burned seven torches of fire. These are the seven spirits of God.
occurrences.kjv: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

occurrences.bsb: And each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within. Day and night they never stop saying: “Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!”
occurrences.kjv: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.

occurrences.bsb: “Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and were created.”
occurrences.kjv: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.

occurrences.bsb: Then I saw a Lamb who appeared to have been slain, standing in the center of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which represent the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
occurrences.kjv: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

occurrences.bsb: And they sang a new song: “Worthy are You to take the scroll and open its seals, because You were slain, and by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation.
occurrences.kjv: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;

occurrences.bsb: You have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our God, and they will reign upon the earth.”
occurrences.kjv: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.

occurrences.bsb: And when the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain for the word of God and for the testimony they had upheld.
occurrences.kjv: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:

occurrences.bsb: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, with the seal of the living God. And he called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea:
occurrences.kjv: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,

occurrences.bsb: “Do not harm the land or sea or trees until we have placed a seal on the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.

occurrences.bsb: And they cried out in a loud voice: “Salvation to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”
occurrences.kjv: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.

occurrences.bsb: And all the angels stood around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures. And they fell facedown before the throne and worshiped God,
occurrences.kjv: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,

occurrences.bsb: saying, “Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: For this reason, they are before the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His temple; and the One seated on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.

occurrences.bsb: For the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. ‘He will lead them to springs of living water,’ and ‘God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’”
occurrences.kjv: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.

occurrences.bsb: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and they were given seven trumpets.
occurrences.kjv: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.

occurrences.bsb: And the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of the saints, rose up before God from the hand of the angel.
occurrences.kjv: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel’s hand.

occurrences.bsb: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
occurrences.kjv: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.

occurrences.bsb: Then the sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar before God
occurrences.kjv: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,

occurrences.bsb: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he begins to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be fulfilled, just as He proclaimed to His servants the prophets.”
occurrences.kjv: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.

occurrences.bsb: Then I was given a measuring rod like a staff and was told, “Go and measure the temple of God and the altar, and count the number of worshipers there.
occurrences.kjv: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.

occurrences.bsb: But after the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered the two witnesses, and they stood on their feet, and great fear fell upon those who saw them.
occurrences.kjv: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.

occurrences.bsb: And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city collapsed. Seven thousand were killed in the quake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
occurrences.kjv: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

occurrences.bsb: And the twenty-four elders who sit on their thrones before God fell on their faces and worshiped God,
occurrences.kjv: And the four and twenty elders, which sat before God on their seats, fell upon their faces, and worshipped God,

occurrences.bsb: saying: “We give thanks to You, O Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because You have taken Your great power and have begun to reign.
occurrences.kjv: Saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God Almighty, which art, and wast, and art to come; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power, and hast reigned.

occurrences.bsb: Then the temple of God in heaven was opened, and the ark of His covenant appeared in His temple. And there were flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, an earthquake, and a great hailstorm.
occurrences.kjv: And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.

occurrences.bsb: And she gave birth to a son, a male child, who will rule all the nations with an iron scepter. And her child was caught up to God and to His throne.
occurrences.kjv: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and to his throne.

occurrences.bsb: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where God had prepared a place for her to be nourished for 1,260 days.
occurrences.kjv: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.

occurrences.bsb: And I heard a loud voice in heaven saying: “Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of His Christ. For the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down—he who accuses them day and night before our God.
occurrences.kjv: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.

occurrences.bsb: And the dragon was enraged at the woman and went to make war with the rest of her children, who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus. And the dragon stood on the shore of the sea.
occurrences.kjv: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: And the beast opened its mouth to speak blasphemies against God and to slander His name and His tabernacle—those who dwell in heaven.
occurrences.kjv: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: These are the ones who have not been defiled with women, for they are virgins. They follow the Lamb wherever He goes. They have been redeemed from among men as firstfruits to God and to the Lamb.
occurrences.kjv: These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.

occurrences.bsb: And he said in a loud voice, “Fear God and give Him glory, because the hour of His judgment has come. Worship the One who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and the springs of waters.”
occurrences.kjv: Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.

occurrences.bsb: he too will drink the wine of God’s anger, poured undiluted into the cup of His wrath. And he will be tormented in fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and of the Lamb.
occurrences.kjv: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:

occurrences.bsb: Here is a call for the perseverance of the saints, who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: So the angel swung his sickle over the earth and gathered the grapes of the earth, and he threw them into the great winepress of God’s wrath.
occurrences.kjv: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.

occurrences.bsb: Then I saw another great and marvelous sign in heaven: seven angels with the seven final plagues, with which the wrath of God is completed.
occurrences.kjv: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.

occurrences.bsb: And I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, beside which stood those who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name. They were holding harps from God,
occurrences.kjv: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.

occurrences.bsb: and they sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: “Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations!
occurrences.kjv: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.

occurrences.bsb: Then one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
occurrences.kjv: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.

occurrences.bsb: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power; and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
occurrences.kjv: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, “Go, pour out on the earth the seven bowls of God’s wrath.”
occurrences.kjv: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.

occurrences.bsb: And I heard the altar reply: “Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are Your judgments.”
occurrences.kjv: And I heard another out of the altar say, Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are thy judgments.

occurrences.bsb: And the people were scorched by intense heat, and they cursed the name of God, who had authority over these plagues. Yet they did not repent and give Him glory.
occurrences.kjv: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, which hath power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.

occurrences.bsb: and curse the God of heaven for their pains and sores. Yet they did not repent of their deeds.
occurrences.kjv: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.

occurrences.bsb: These are demonic spirits that perform signs and go out to all the kings of the earth, to assemble them for battle on the great day of God the Almighty.
occurrences.kjv: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.

occurrences.bsb: The great city was split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed. And God remembered Babylon the great and gave her the cup of the wine of the fury of His wrath.
occurrences.kjv: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

occurrences.bsb: And great hailstones weighing almost a hundred pounds each rained down on them from above. And men cursed God for the plague of hail, because it was so horrendous.
occurrences.kjv: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.

occurrences.bsb: For God has put it into their hearts to carry out His purpose by uniting to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.
occurrences.kjv: For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: For her sins are piled up to heaven, and God has remembered her iniquities.
occurrences.kjv: For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore her plagues will come in one day—death and grief and famine—and she will be consumed by fire, for mighty is the Lord God who judges her.”
occurrences.kjv: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.

occurrences.bsb: Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, because God has pronounced for you His judgment against her.
occurrences.kjv: Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.

occurrences.bsb: After this I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude in heaven, shouting: “Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God!
occurrences.kjv: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto the Lord our God:

occurrences.bsb: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying: “Amen, Hallelujah!”
occurrences.kjv: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Alleluia.

occurrences.bsb: Then a voice came from the throne, saying: “Praise our God, all you who serve Him, and those who fear Him, small and great alike!”
occurrences.kjv: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all ye his servants, and ye that fear him, both small and great.

occurrences.bsb: And I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude, like the rushing of many waters, and like a mighty rumbling of thunder, crying out: “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.
occurrences.kjv: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.

occurrences.bsb: Then the angel told me to write, “Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.” And he said to me, “These are the true words of God.”
occurrences.kjv: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.

occurrences.bsb: So I fell at his feet to worship him. But he told me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers who rely on the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.”
occurrences.kjv: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See thou do it not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.

occurrences.bsb: He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and His name is The Word of God.
occurrences.kjv: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.

occurrences.bsb: And from His mouth proceeds a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and He will rule them with an iron scepter. He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
occurrences.kjv: And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.

occurrences.bsb: Then I saw an angel standing in the sun, and he cried out in a loud voice to all the birds flying overhead, “Come, gather together for the great supper of God,
occurrences.kjv: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God;

occurrences.bsb: Then I saw the thrones, and those seated on them had been given authority to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for their testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received its mark on their foreheads or hands. And they came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
occurrences.kjv: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection! The second death has no power over them, but they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with Him for a thousand years.
occurrences.kjv: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.

occurrences.bsb: I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
occurrences.kjv: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

occurrences.bsb: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying: “Behold, the dwelling place of God is with man, and He will dwell with them. They will be His people, and God Himself will be with them as their God.
occurrences.kjv: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God.

occurrences.bsb: The one who overcomes will inherit all things, and I will be his God, and he will be My son.
occurrences.kjv: He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.

occurrences.bsb: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a mountain great and high, and showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down out of heaven from God,
occurrences.kjv: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and shewed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God,

occurrences.bsb: shining with the glory of God. Its radiance was like a most precious jewel, like a jasper, as clear as crystal.
occurrences.kjv: Having the glory of God: and her light was like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

occurrences.bsb: But I saw no temple in the city, because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
occurrences.kjv: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.

occurrences.bsb: And the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, because the glory of God illuminates the city, and the Lamb is its lamp.
occurrences.kjv: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.

occurrences.bsb: Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb
occurrences.kjv: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.

occurrences.bsb: No longer will there be any curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be within the city, and His servants will worship Him.
occurrences.kjv: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:

occurrences.bsb: There will be no more night in the city, and they will have no need for the light of a lamp or of the sun. For the Lord God will shine on them, and they will reign forever and ever.
occurrences.kjv: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.

occurrences.bsb: Then the angel said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent His angel to show His servants what must soon take place.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto me, These sayings are faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.

occurrences.bsb: But he said to me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God!”
occurrences.kjv: Then saith he unto me, See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.

occurrences.bsb: I testify to everyone who hears the words of prophecy in this book: If anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book.
occurrences.kjv: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:

occurrences.bsb: And if anyone takes away from the words of this book of prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life and the holy city, which are described in this book.
occurrences.kjv: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.
